title: Contents Packout & Storage — Declared-Value Coverage and Custody Liability Figures
content:
Terms of custody for Contents Packout & Storage, by tier: whether the customer may buy declared-value coverage for items in storage, what that coverage costs per storage period, the company's maximum liability for an item lost or damaged in its custody without declared-value coverage, and the window for reporting loss or damage after the contents come home.

| Term | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Customer may buy declared-value coverage for items in storage | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Charge per storage period for declared-value coverage, percent of the declared value | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.75 | 0.65 |
| Company's maximum liability per item lost or damaged in its custody without declared-value coverage, USD | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 |
| Calendar days after the contents are returned within which loss or damage in custody must be reported | 3 | 5 | 7 | 7 | 10 | 10 |

## Points of judgement

- **Where coverage is offered.** Declared-value coverage can be bought on the four packout tiers only; the two tiers without storage do not offer it.
- **What the percentage is.** The coverage charge is a percentage of the declared value per storage period: 0.85 percent on Partial and Full Contents Packout, 0.75 percent on High-Value Contents Packout and 0.65 percent on Commercial Contents and Records Recovery.
- **Liability figure.** The per-item liability figure is the cap that applies where the customer did not buy declared-value coverage.

**Hypothetical illustration.** At a coverage percentage of 0.5 percent (not a tier figure), a declared value of 8,000.00 costs 8,000.00 times 0.5 divided by one hundred, or 40.00, per storage period.
